subject.title: Support Qwen Cloud personal token plan, and unblock Alibaba Token Plan on Linux

question: Should CodexBar officially support Qwen Cloud personal Token Plan as an Alibaba Token Plan region when setup requires users to manually export a browser Cookie header on every platform?
rationale: This is a new provider mode and configuration value, and the PR deliberately declines browser import because Qwen authentication and cookie scope differ from the existing Alibaba flow.

options.title: Approve the manual-cookie region
options.body: Treat the documented manual Cookie-header flow as supported, subject to runtime proof and public API compatibility handling.

options.title: Defer Qwen personal-plan support
options.body: Keep the existing team-plan-only provider until a lower-friction and explicitly supported authentication flow is available.

recommendation.title: Approve the manual-cookie region
recommendation.body: Treat the documented manual Cookie-header flow as supported, subject to runtime proof and public API compatibility handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the new supported authentication workflow make this a product-direction decision.
